supportingSources.label: Surf Champ restoration and feature guide
Gene Lewin at INDISC 2023 Classics I — Tiebreaker for Quarterfinals

strategy.summary: Collect the five center stars to raise the upper-right hole to 5,000. Repeat the hole. Use a lit side lane for 2x, or 3x on the final ball.

steps.text: Test the left-orbit feed, upper-right-hole kickout, side-lane exits, and the spinner rebound. Plunge a lit top lane when its feed is safer than the left orbit.
modeNotes: Surfer is the two-player version of Surf Champ. Both games have the same playfield rules.

steps.text: Shoot through the five center star rollovers. Use paths that continue to a drop target or the upper-right hole.
modeNotes: Star rollovers: Each collected star changes the hole through 500, 1,400, 2,300, 3,200, 4,100, then 5,000.
All five stars also light the spinner for the rest of the ball and light the side-lane multiplier award.

steps.text: After several stars are collected, shoot the upper-right hole from the left flipper. Repeat it at 5,000 when the kickout is controlled.
Send the ball up the left orbit or through safe upper shots. Use lit top lanes to build base bonus faster.
modeNotes: Top lanes: Each scores 500. An unlit lane adds one bonus step. The one lit lane adds two, three, or five steps, based on settings.
Spinner hits move the lit top lane.

steps.text: After all five stars are collected, roll through a lit side lane to raise Bonus X once on that ball.
modeNotes: Side-lane multiplier: Raises 1x to 2x on normal balls. On the final ball, which starts at 2x, it raises bonus to 3x.
The award can be collected only once per ball.

steps.text: Roll through the top lanes and upper-left lane until base bonus reaches 15,000. Protect it at 2x, or 3x on the final ball.
modeNotes: Maximum bonus: 30,000 on normal balls and 45,000 on the final ball. Base bonus and Bonus X reset after collection.

fallback.title: Bonus and left orbit
fallback.when: Use this when the upper-right hole rejects or its kickout is not controlled.

steps.text: Repeat the left orbit when its return is safe.
Roll through the top lanes and upper-left lane until base bonus reaches a useful value.
Collect a lit side lane for 2x, or 3x on the final ball.
Do not force the upper-right hole.

alternatives.title: Drop-bank award
alternatives.when: Use this when the drop rebounds are controlled and several targets are already down.

steps.text: Finish all five drops. The bank resets and scores 5,000.
The left outlane lights for extra ball and the right outlane lights for Special. Use them only when the event gives useful value.
Collect all five stars and repeat the upper-right hole.
On the final ball, collect the lit side lane for 3x.
Roll through the top lanes and upper-left lane until base bonus reaches 15,000. Drain without tilting.

techniques.name: Backhand
techniques.instruction: Backhand the two upper-right drop targets from the left flipper. The right-flipper forehand is blocked by the spinner post.

techniques.name: Right-flipper left orbit
techniques.instruction: Shoot the left orbit from the right flipper to return the ball to the top. Use it only after its lower exit is known.

cautions.issue: The upper-right-hole kickout fires the ball into the right bumper.
cautions.response: Watch the first eject. Repeat the hole only when the bumper exit is recoverable.

cautions.issue: The second star rollover from the right feeds the right bumper and can rebound toward a drain.
cautions.response: Collect it through a controlled angled shot or safe ricochet. Do not force a direct shot after the hole is already valuable.

cautions.issue: Side-lane exits can drain through the center or hit a sling mount and become uncontrolled.
cautions.response: Watch the first exit from each side. Nudge before the ball reaches the lower post or sling mount.

cautions.issue: Direct drop-target and spinner rebounds can head toward the bumpers or center.
cautions.response: Use the star-to-hole route when these rebounds are not controlled. Shoot drops only when the bank award is close.

quickInfo.name: Main route
quickInfo.summary: Collect the five center stars to raise the upper-right hole to 5,000.

quickInfo.name: Long goal
quickInfo.summary: Collect all five stars and repeat the upper-right hole.

quickInfo.name: Safer fallback
quickInfo.summary: Bonus and left orbit: Use this when the upper-right hole rejects or its kickout is not controlled.

noteDetails.label: Top-player proof
items: At INDISC 2023, Gene Lewin used the five-star progress into the upper-right-hole route while building bonus and looking for the lit side lane multiplier, finishing with 73,230.

strategy.simpleOverview: In Surf Champ or Surfer, rolling over the five center stars raises the upper-right hole to 5,000 and lights the side-lane Bonus X award. Collect all five stars, repeat the upper-right hole while its kickout is controlled, then roll through a lit side lane for 2x Bonus (or 3x on the final ball).
strategy.overview: In Surf Champ or Surfer, each center star raises the upper-right hole, and all five stars light the spinner and side-lane Bonus X award. Complete the stars, repeat the 5,000 hole, then collect a lit side lane for 2x Bonus (or 3x on the final ball). Use top lanes and drop targets to build 15,000 base bonus before the drain.
